name: Automated Code Review
outcome: Design and evaluate an automated review workflow that supports independent human and scientific validation.
description: Move from general QA to repeatable review of changes. Combine static checks, review rubrics and agent findings while measuring false positives and missed defects.
learn: Create a structured review rubric for scientific software
Combine agent review with independent static and dynamic checks
Measure review precision and recall against seeded defects
tools: Claude Code CLI or Codex CLI (choose one)
prior: Git diff and pull-request review; Python and static-analysis basics
practice: Review two small supplied diffs in the SSC Lotka–Volterra project containing documented, seeded defects.
acceptance: Findings are traceable to code and evidence; at least one false positive or missed defect is discussed; final acceptance remains a human decision.
external: Git diff and pull-request review; Python and static-analysis basics
moduleDescriptions: Set criteria for correctness, maintainability and scientific validity.
Generate findings with file locations, severity and evidence.
Confirm findings using tests and static checks; reject unsupported claims.
Measure missed defects and false alarms; decide whether to accept the patch.
prerequisiteRationale: S04 establishes the verification targets and test evidence; S09 specializes in reproducible change review and evaluation of reviewer quality.
